name: AILinkMaster: Auto Internal Links & SEO
author: aivc

sections.description:
AILinkMaster is a smart solution for WordPress publishers who want to improve SEO via internal linking without manual work.

The plugin now operates in two powerful modes to ensure maximum performance:

  1. Static (Standard): Links are calculated once and frozen in the database. This ensures zero load on your server for visitors.
  2. Hybrid: Keeps fresh articles dynamic for a set period (to test linking strategies), then automatically freezes them into Static mode.

It also includes a unique Keyword Scanner to find linking opportunities you missed.

🚀 Key Features

  • Smart Internal Linking: Automatically link keywords to your money pages or categories.
  • Intelligent Caching: All links are eventually frozen to ensure your site stays fast.
  • 🕵️‍♂️ Keyword Scanner: Scans your last 200 posts to find frequent words that do not have links yet.
  • Orphan Search: Instantly find “Orphan” posts that have zero internal inbound links.
  • UTM Support: Automatically adds UTM tags to internal links for tracking.

🛡️ Flexible Rules

  • Limit links per post (Global Limit).
  • Limit links per keyword (Word Limit).
  • “Skip Intro”: Don’t link words in the first X characters of the article.
  • Weighted Pools: Rotate target URLs for the same keyword to avoid patterns.

Configuration Guide

Understanding how limits and modes work will help you get the best SEO results.

⚙️ Logic Hierarchy

  1. Max Outgoing (Global Limit): This is the “Boss” setting. Even if your rules find 50 keywords, the plugin will stop inserting links once this limit is reached (e.g., 5 links per post).
  2. Limit Total (Rule Level): Controls diversity. Example: You allow 5 links per post globally, but only 2 links for the keyword “Bitcoin”.
  3. Target Limit (Incoming): Protects your donor pages. If a specific page already has X incoming auto-links, the plugin will stop linking to it to avoid over-optimization.

🛠 Modes Explained

  • Static (Standard): Links are generated once and saved (“frozen”) in the database.
    • Pros: Zero load on your site speed.
    • Note: If you change Global Settings (like “Skip Intro”), they apply to frozen links instantly. But if you change specific Keywords, you must use the “Unfreeze ALL” button to regenerate old posts.
  • Hybrid: Keeps fresh articles dynamic for X days.
    • Use case: Allows you to tweak rules for new content. After X days, links automatically freeze to save resources.

📐 Positioning

  • Skip Intro: The number of characters to skip at the beginning of the article. Useful to keep your introduction clean and readable.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the ailinkmaster-internal-auto-manager folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings -> AILinkMaster to configure your keywords and rules.
sections.faq:
How does Static mode work?

The plugin calculates links based on your rules when the page is first visited (or updated). It then saves these links to the database. On subsequent visits, it serves these saved links, respecting your “Skip Intro” and “Global Limit” settings instantly.

What is the “Hybrid” mode?

It allows you to test links on new articles dynamically. After a set period (e.g., 30 days), the plugin “freezes” the current link structure for that post, making it permanent and saving server resources.

1.0

  • Initial release.
